purpose: RID concept options for user selection; not CAD or hardware validation
common_constraints:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic industrial design concept photograph for creative direction, one portable drone Remote ID (RID) receiver per image.
Primary request: Original modern handheld RID instrument inspired by the disciplined functionalism of Dieter Rams and classic 1960s Braun industrial design. Extremely restrained, useful, timeless, pure geometry, continuous-curvature rounded corners blending smoothly into flat straight sides. Small palm-size device, not a smartphone, not an SSD, not a radio with a speaker. Internal antennas, no protruding antenna. Integrate a real-looking 2.0-inch square AMOLED screen, approximately 36 x 36 mm visible area, aspect ratio precisely 1:1. A recessed, precisely formed USB-C charging/data port is visible on the bottom edge.
Surface and graphics: exceptionally uniform matte finish; tiny precise panel seams, no glossy bevels, no decorative grooves, no checkered logo, no screws on the front, no ornamental rings or tickmarks. Black Helvetica typography printed on the case, tiny but crisply legible, meticulous Swiss grid alignment. Only essential product/model identification and a small control label. Do not print Braun or Apple trademarks or logos.
Display: completely monochrome black/off-white RID interface, three thin radar range rings, a small aircraft dot and heading arrow, very restrained readings "168 m" and "+62 m", and a small "DEMO" indicator. Screen flush and low-reflection, restrained black border, not a full-face phone display. No colored UI, LEDs or light strips.
Photography: landscape 3:2 image. One entire product, comfortably centered, occupies approximately 65 percent of the frame, generous empty space, no cropping. Low-distortion 100 mm lens, near-orthographic three-quarter view from slightly above, front face and right side and bottom USB-C edge clearly visible. Deep depth of field, the whole device sharp. A museum-quality industrial object study, not a dramatic advertising scene. Plain seamless warm light gray / warm ivory background, only slightly different in tone from the body. Very soft, nondirectional diffuse skylight, flat lighting, faint feathered contact shadow, no hard highlights, no strong reflections, no vignette, no bokeh, no props, no cable, no hands, no supporting pedestal, no background text, no captions or diagram overlays.
Color rule: the case is entirely neutral gray-white or satin silver, all text black, display achromatic. Exactly ONE physically functional control on the RIGHT SIDE WALL is the only saturated color in the entire image. Keep that side control unobscured in the chosen view. It must be a real operable control, not a color patch or decorative trim.
